summary: Retest of iteration_27 fixes for Fase 2 Bidirectional Stock Sync. Both corrections applied and verified via live API against tricomar.cl integration. sync-from-ps now accepts JSON object body {product_ids:[...]} and returns 200; sync-to-ps returns proper 404 for missing product (previously 500). All previously-passing checks continue to pass. Full E2E product sync still blocked by empty product DB (out of scope for this retest).
passed: CORRECCIÓN 1: POST /stock/sync-from-ps with {"product_ids":[999999]} -> HTTP 200, {success:true, synced_count:0, conflicts_detected:0, errors:[], timestamp}
POST /stock/sync-from-ps with empty {} body -> HTTP 200 (backward compatible for full sync)
Schema change confirmed: raw array [1,2,3] now correctly rejected with 422 model_attributes_type (expected new behavior after Pydantic model wrap)
CORRECCIÓN 2: POST /stock/sync-to-ps?product_id=nonexistent&quantity=10 -> HTTP 404 {detail:'Producto no encontrado'} (was 500 in iter_27)
Regression: POST /stock/sync-to-ps negative quantity -> HTTP 400 'La cantidad no puede ser negativa'
Regression: POST /stock/sync-to-ps invalid integration id -> HTTP 404 'Integración no encontrada'
Regression: GET /stock/conflicts -> HTTP 200, correct shop_url multi-tenant isolation
action_items: The 'no está sincronizado con PrestaShop' -> 400 mapping could not be exercised because DB still has no products with prestashop_id assigned. Code path is in place (line 2887-2894) but requires a product in DB to verify end-to-end. Non-blocking.
E2E real PrestaShop XML PUT (id_shop multi-shop) still pending until at least one product is synced into DB.
notes: Both issues from iteration_27 (MEDIUM: body schema; LOW: error mapping) are resolved. Backend hot-reload picked up changes without manual restart.
